name: Wen Ko-hsin
source: After meeting the protagonist for the first time during the Hanyang Iron Works case, she is able to contribute valuable clues that are essential to solving each case through her independent investigations every time she appears. As a journalist, she is adamant about digging deep to search for the truth. Her literary talent has also been widely praised,
